text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they learn from unfair data, which may lead to wrong decisions about people. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it carefully. Transparency is another key idea: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and helpful for society. Governments, companies, and scientists must work together to make sure AI is used in the right way.
